starving.name: Starving
starving.description: Severe hunger weakens the character and reduces effectiveness.

dehydrated.name: Dehydrated
dehydrated.description: Lack of water causes weakness and slower recovery.

exhausted.name: Exhausted
exhausted.description: Lack of sleep reduces concentration and performance.

addiction.name: Addiction
addiction.description: Character suffers penalties without substance use.

chemEffect.name: Chem Effect
chemEffect.description: Temporary bonuses or penalties from substances.

wellFed.name: Well Fed
wellFed.description: Provides bonuses from proper nutrition and hydration.

exposure.name: Exposure
exposure.description: Causes fatigue due to environmental conditions.

unconscious.name: Unconscious
unconscious.description: Unable to act until stabilized or healed.

dying.name: Dying
dying.description: Requires immediate stabilization to avoid death.

invisible.name: Invisible
invisible.description: Harder to detect and increases defense.

blind.name: Blind
blind.description: Cannot see, affecting accuracy and perception.

fear.name: Fear
fear.description: Attempts to flee or loses control under stress.

resistance.name: Resistance
resistance.description: Reduces damage of a specific type.

berryMentats.name: Berry Mentats
berryMentats.description: Reduce the difficulty of INT tests by 2.

buffjet.name: Buffjet
buffjet.description: Reduce STR and END test difficulty by 1, gain +4 Max HP, gain 3 AP immediately, and extra actions cost 1 less AP.

buffout.name: Buffout
buffout.description: Re-roll 1d20 on STR and END tests and gain +3 Max HP.

bufftats.name: Bufftats
bufftats.description: Reduce STR, PER, and END test difficulty by 1 and gain +4 Max HP.

calmex.name: Calmex
calmex.description: Re-roll 1d20 on PER and AGI tests and gain +2 CD to sneak attack damage.

daddyO.name: Daddy-O
daddyO.description: Reduce PER and INT test difficulty by 1, but CHA tests become harder.

dayTripper.name: Day Tripper
dayTripper.description: Improves social and luck-related performance for a lasting duration.

fury.name: Fury
fury.description: Boosts aggressive combat performance for a lasting duration.

grapeMentats.name: Grape Mentats
grapeMentats.description: Improves social ability and trading performance for a lasting duration.

jet.name: Jet
jet.description: Grants a short burst of speed and action advantage.

jetFuel.name: Jet Fuel
jetFuel.description: A stronger Jet variant with a longer-lasting effect.

medX.name: Med-X
medX.description: Reduces incoming harm and helps endure combat longer.

mentats.name: Mentats
mentats.description: Improves mental performance and concentration for a lasting duration.

orangeMentats.name: Orange Mentats
orangeMentats.description: Improves perception and ranged combat awareness for a lasting duration.

overdrive.name: Overdrive
overdrive.description: Improves aggressive combat output for a lasting duration.

psycho.name: Psycho
psycho.description: Boosts damage potential and aggression for a lasting duration.

psychoJet.name: Psycho Jet
psychoJet.description: Combines Psycho aggression with Jet speed for a brief duration.

psychobuff.name: Psychobuff
psychobuff.description: Combines Psycho and Buffout effects for a lasting duration.

psychotats.name: Psychotats
psychotats.description: Combines Psycho and Mentats-style benefits for a lasting duration.

radXDiluted.name: Diluted Rad-X
radXDiluted.description: A weaker version of Rad-X that still improves radiation resistance.

skeetoSpit.name: Skeeto Spit
skeetoSpit.description: A wasteland remedy with a lasting chemical effect.

ultraJet.name: Ultra Jet
ultraJet.description: An advanced Jet variant with a powerful brief effect.

xCell.name: X-Cell
xCell.description: A rare and powerful chem that enhances overall performance.

buffoutAddiction.name: Buffout Addiction
buffoutAddiction.description: While not under a Buffout-type effect, STR and END tests are +1 difficulty.

mentatAddiction.name: Mentat Addiction
mentatAddiction.description: While not under a Mentats-type effect, CHA tests are +1 difficulty.

calmexAddiction.name: Calmex Addiction
calmexAddiction.description: While not under Calmex, AGI tests suffer complications on rolls of 18 or higher.

daddyOAddiction.name: Daddy-O Addiction
daddyOAddiction.description: While not under Daddy-O, PER and INT tests are +1 difficulty.

dayTripperAddiction.name: Day Tripper Addiction
dayTripperAddiction.description: While not under Day Tripper, CHA and LCK tests are +1 difficulty.

furyAddiction.name: Fury Addiction
furyAddiction.description: While not under Fury, STR and PER tests are +1 difficulty.

jetAddiction.name: Jet Addiction
jetAddiction.description: While not under a Jet-type effect, AGI tests are +1 difficulty.

medXAddiction.name: Med-X Addiction
medXAddiction.description: While not under Med-X, AGI tests are +1 difficulty and physical attacks deal +1 CD damage to you.

overdriveAddiction.name: Overdrive Addiction
overdriveAddiction.description: While not under Overdrive, STR and AGI tests are +1 difficulty.

psychoAddiction.name: Psycho Addiction
psychoAddiction.description: While not under a Psycho-type effect, STR tests are +1 difficulty and physical attacks deal +1 CD damage to you.

ultraJetAddiction.name: Ultra Jet Addiction
ultraJetAddiction.description: While not under Ultra Jet, AGI tests are +1 difficulty and you generate 1 fewer AP on successful tests.

xCellAddiction.name: X-Cell Addiction
xCellAddiction.description: While not under X-Cell, all tests are +1 difficulty.

bloodWorms.name: Blood Worms
bloodWorms.description: A disease that weakens the body over time.

boneWorms.name: Bone Worms
boneWorms.description: A disease that causes deep internal pain and weakness.

buzzBrain.name: Buzz Brain
buzzBrain.description: A disease that clouds thought and concentration.

dysentery.name: Dysentery
dysentery.description: A severe illness that weakens the body and endurance.

feverClaw.name: Fever Claw
feverClaw.description: A disease that brings fever and physical stress.

flapLimb.name: Flap Limb
flapLimb.description: A disease that interferes with reliable movement.

glowingPustules.name: Glowing Pustules
glowingPustules.description: A radiation-linked disease causing painful eruptions.

heatFlashes.name: Heat Flashes
heatFlashes.description: A disease causing sudden weakness and discomfort.

jellyFingers.name: Jelly Fingers
jellyFingers.description: A disease that makes precise hand use more difficult.

lockJoint.name: Lock Joint
lockJoint.description: A disease that causes stiffness and impaired movement.

needleSpine.name: Needle Spine
needleSpine.description: A painful disease affecting posture and comfort.

parasites.name: Parasites
parasites.description: A lingering illness that drains strength and recovery.

shellShock.name: Shell Shock
shellShock.description: A trauma-like condition affecting nerves and stability.

sludgeLung.name: Sludge Lung
sludgeLung.description: A disease affecting breathing and endurance.

snotEar.name: Snot Ear
snotEar.description: A disease that affects comfort and awareness.

swampGas.name: Swamp Gas
swampGas.description: A swamp-borne disease causing weakness and discomfort.

swampItch.name: Swamp Itch
swampItch.description: A persistent disease causing irritation and distraction.

theWhoopsies.name: The Whoopsies
theWhoopsies.description: A serious wasteland disease with debilitating symptoms.

weepingSores.name: Weeping Sores
weepingSores.description: A disease causing painful open sores and weakness.

head.crippled: Lose next normal actions. Vision tests are +2 difficulty.
head.treated: Head stabilized. Vision and focus may still be impaired.

torso.crippled: Heavy bleeding. Take ongoing damage each turn.
torso.treated: Bleeding controlled, but the wound is still serious.

leftArm.crippled: Drop held item. That arm cannot be used.
leftArm.treated: Arm stabilized, but use remains limited.

rightArm.crippled: Drop held item. That arm cannot be used.
rightArm.treated: Arm stabilized, but use remains limited.

leftLeg.crippled: Fall prone. No sprint. Moving is slower.
leftLeg.treated: Leg stabilized, but mobility is still reduced.

rightLeg.crippled: Fall prone. No sprint. Moving is slower.
rightLeg.treated: Leg stabilized, but mobility is still reduced.

unsavedChanges.title: UNSAVED CHANGES
unsavedChanges.message: You have unsaved changes. Export the current record before leaving this screen.

persistent.name: Persistent
persistent.description: If effects are rolled, the target takes the weapon’s damage again at the end of future turns for several rounds. They can use an action to try to stop it early.

piercing1.name: Piercing 1
piercing1.description: Each effect ignores part of the target’s DR. The ignored amount depends on the weapon’s Piercing rating.

piercing2.name: Piercing 2
piercing2.description: Each effect ignores part of the target’s DR. The ignored amount depends on the weapon’s Piercing rating.

piercing3.name: Piercing 3
piercing3.description: Each effect ignores part of the target’s DR. The ignored amount depends on the weapon’s Piercing rating.

piercing4.name: Piercing 4
piercing4.description: Each effect ignores part of the target’s DR. The ignored amount depends on the weapon’s Piercing rating.

radioactive.name: Radioactive
radioactive.description: Each effect also adds extra radiation damage, resolved separately after the main hit.

spread.name: Spread
spread.description: Each effect creates an extra hit on the same target. Extra hits deal half damage and strike random locations.

stun.name: Stun
stun.description: If at least one effect is rolled, the target loses their normal actions on their next turn.

vicious.name: Vicious
vicious.description: Each effect increases the total damage dealt.

burst.name: Burst
burst.description: Each effect can hit another target near the main one, spending additional ammunition.

breaking.name: Breaking
breaking.description: Each effect weakens cover or, if there is no cover, reduces DR on the struck location for the weapon’s damage type.

accurate.name: Accurate
accurate.description: Works best when aimed carefully. You can spend AP after aiming to add extra damage dice.

blast.name: Blast
blast.description: Targets a whole zone instead of one enemy. On failure, it still deals reduced area damage.

closeQuarters.name: Close Quarters
closeQuarters.description: Does not suffer extra difficulty when used within reach of an enemy.

concealed.name: Concealed
concealed.description: Easy to hide unless openly carried or found during a proper search.

debilitating.name: Debilitating
debilitating.description: Injuries caused by this weapon are harder to treat.

gatling.name: Gatling
gatling.description: Consumes ammo in large bursts and gains stronger bonus damage when extra ammo is spent.

mine.name: Mine
mine.description: Can be placed and primed to damage creatures that move close to it.

parry.name: Parry
parry.description: Can improve your Defense against incoming melee attacks by spending AP.

recon.name: Recon
recon.description: After aiming, the next ally attacking that target gains a re-roll benefit.

reliable.name: Reliable
reliable.description: Ignores the first complication rolled with that weapon in each combat encounter.

suppressed.name: Suppressed
suppressed.description: Harder for enemies to notice when fired from stealth.

thrown.name: Thrown
thrown.description: Can be used as a ranged attack with a listed throwing range.

twoHanded.name: Two-Handed
twoHanded.description: Needs both hands for normal use. One-handed attacks are much harder.

unreliable.name: Unreliable
unreliable.description: Raises the chance of complications when used.

mapPanel.title: MAP
mapPanel.campRest: You set up camp to rest +8h

hazardsDesc.danger: Deals periodic physical damage from hidden fire or hazards.

commonwealth.nuka_fridge: Loot: An old Nuka-Cola fridge. There might be something useful inside.
commonwealth.metro_station: Metro station. It might be worth exploring.
commonwealth.cave: A dark and eerie cave. It might be worth exploring.
commonwealth.west_tek_building: A West-Tek facility. Dangerous, but potentially valuable.
commonwealth.bus_station: A bus station. There could be supplies or survivors here.
commonwealth.mine: An abandoned mine. It's dark and silent inside.
commonwealth.super_duper_mart: Super Duper Mart. Might be worth checking the shelves and storage.
commonwealth.raider_outpost: A raider outpost. Someone is definitely here.
commonwealth.mutant_outpost: A super mutant outpost. Stay alert.
commonwealth.bos_outpost: Brotherhood of Steel outpost. Their reaction depends on your reputation.
commonwealth.ncr_outpost: NCR outpost. Could be trade... or interrogation.
commonwealth.settlement: A small settlement. You may find rest, rumors, or trade opportunities.
commonwealth.ambush: Ambush! You are attacked. Enemies strike first.
commonwealth.rad_waste_pit: You fall into a pit of radioactive waste. Take radiation damage.
commonwealth.lost_supplies: You lost some supplies during travel.
commonwealth.broken_backpack: Your backpack is torn. Some of your gear is lost.
commonwealth.fatal_breakdown: Critical failure. Your equipped weapon or armor breaks and becomes unusable.
commonwealth.food_poisoning: You ate something bad and got poisoned.
commonwealth.hunger_crash: Your hunger drops to 0. You also gain 1 level of exhaustion.
commonwealth.toxic_puddle: Toxic puddle. You are exposed to poison or lose leg protection.
commonwealth.pickpocket: Pickpocket. One unequipped item is stolen from your inventory.
commonwealth.building_collapse: A collapsing building falls on you. Take physical damage.
commonwealth.grenade_tripwire: Grenade tripwire! You and adjacent allies take physical damage.
commonwealth.stuck_in_textures: You got stuck in the terrain. You cannot move until you take a long rest.
commonwealth.overload: Over-encumbered. Drop items or gain 1 level of exhaustion.

weird.mr_gutsy_drill: A group of Mister Gutsy robots mistakes you for training participants.
weird.cult_preachers: A strange cult tries to recruit you.
weird.wasteland_convention: Fans of pre-war culture are organizing a bizarre wasteland convention.
weird.super_mutant_tech: Super mutants are attempting to operate advanced pre-war technology.
weird.rickshaw_taxi: A makeshift taxi offers you a ride for caps.
weird.vault_wanderer: A vault dweller asks for help repairing their vault systems.

characterCreation.selectOriginDescription: Choose your character's origin to determine base traits, maximum skills, and special abilities.
characterCreation.chooseTwoTraits: Choose two of the following traits, or one trait and one additional perk.

vault_kid.name: Vault Kid
vault_kid.desc: Your healthier start to life at the hands of trained doctors...

survivor.name: Survivor
survivor.desc: You are the living legacy of the people who prepared for Armageddon on their own.

chain_that_binds.name: The Chain That Binds
chain_that_binds.desc: You must obey the orders of those above you in the Brotherhood of Steel hierarchy.

necrotic_post_human.name: Necrotic Post-Human
necrotic_post_human.desc: Immune to radiation damage and hazards. Radiation heals you instead of harming you.

forced_evolution.name: Forced Evolution
forced_evolution.desc: Your initial Strength and Endurance attributes are increased by +2 each...

mister_handy_robot.name: Mister Handy Robot
mister_handy_robot.desc: You have 360° vision and improved sensory systems...

educated.name: Educated (Trait)
educated.desc: You have one additional tag skill.

fast_shot.name: Fast Shot (Trait)
fast_shot.desc: If you take a second major action in combat, and use it to make a ranged attack...

gifted.name: Gifted (Trait)
gifted.desc: Choose two S.P.E.C.I.A.L. attributes and increase them by +1 each...

heavy_handed.name: Heavy Handed (Trait)
heavy_handed.desc: Your Melee Damage bonus increases by +1...

small_frame.name: Small Frame (Trait)
small_frame.desc: You may re-roll 1d20 on all AGI tests which rely on balance or contortion...

action_boy_girl.name: Action Boy/Girl
action_boy_girl.desc: When you spend AP to take an additional major action, you do not suffer the increased skill test difficulty.

adamantium_skeleton.name: Adamantium Skeleton
adamantium_skeleton.desc: The amount of damage needed to inflict a critical hit on you increases by your rank in this perk.

adrenalin_rush.name: Adrenalin Rush
adrenalin_rush.desc: When your health is below its maximum value, you count your STR score as 10 for STR-based tests or melee attacks.

animal_friend.name: Animal Friend
animal_friend.desc: Animals may choose not to attack you. Higher ranks allow you to pacify them.

aquaboy_aquagirl.name: Aquaboy/Aquagirl
aquaboy_aquagirl.desc: You no longer take radiation damage from swimming and can hold your breath twice as long.

armorer.name: Armorer
armorer.desc: You can modify armor with armor mods up to your rank in this perk.

awareness.name: Awareness
awareness.desc: When you take the Aim action, you spot weaknesses. The next attack gains Piercing 1.

barbarian.name: Barbarian
barbarian.desc: Your physical Damage Resistance increases on all hit locations based on your STR score.

basher.name: Basher
basher.desc: When you make a melee attack by bashing with your gun, your attack gains the Vicious damage effect.

better_criticals.name: Better Criticals
better_criticals.desc: When you inflict damage, you may spend 1 Luck Point to automatically inflict a critical hit.

big_leagues.name: Big Leagues
big_leagues.desc: When you make a melee attack with a two-handed melee weapon, the weapon gains the Vicious effect.

black_widow_lady_killer.name: Black Widow / Lady Killer
black_widow_lady_killer.desc: Re-roll 1d20 on CHA tests to influence specific genders. Attacks inflict +1 damage against them.

blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
blacksmith.desc: You can modify melee weapons with weapon mods up to your rank in this perk.

blitz.name: Blitz
blitz.desc: When you move into reach and attack in one turn, you may re-roll one d20 on your attack.

bloody_mess.name: Bloody Mess
bloody_mess.desc: When you inflict a critical hit, roll 1 CD; on an Effect, you inflict an additional injury.

can_do.name: Can Do!
can_do.desc: When scavenging a location with food, you gain 1 additional random food item without spending AP.

cap_collector.name: Cap Collector
cap_collector.desc: When you buy or sell items, you may increase or decrease the price by 10%.

cautious_nature.name: Cautious Nature
cautious_nature.desc: Whenever you buy d20s by spending AP, you may re-roll 1d20 on that test.

center_mass.name: Center Mass
center_mass.desc: Make ranged attacks against the Torso without increasing difficulty. Re-roll 1d20 on the test.

chem_resistant.name: Chem Resistant
chem_resistant.desc: Roll fewer CD when checking for addiction. At rank 2, you are immune to addiction.

paralyzing_palm.name: Paralyzing Palm
paralyzing_palm.desc: When you make an unarmed attack and target a specific location, your attack gains the Stun damage effect.

party_boy_girl.name: Party Boy/Party Girl
party_boy_girl.desc: You cannot become addicted to alcoholic drinks, and whenever you drink an alcoholic drink, you heal +2 HP.

pathfinder.name: Pathfinder
pathfinder.desc: When travelling over long distances, a successful PER + Survival test reduces the travel time by half.

pharma_farma.name: Pharma Farma
pharma_farma.desc: When scavenging a location with medicine or chems, you find one additional item randomly determined, without spending AP.

pickpocket.name: Pickpocket
pickpocket.desc: Rank 1: Ignore first complication on pickpocketing. Rank 2: Re-roll 1d20. Rank 3: Reduce difficulty by 1.

piercing_strike.name: Piercing Strike
piercing_strike.desc: Your attacks using unarmed and bladed melee weapons gain the Piercing 1 damage effect (or add +1 to existing).

pyromaniac.name: Pyromaniac
pyromaniac.desc: The damage you deal using fire-based weapons increases by +1 CD per rank.

quick_draw.name: Quick Draw
quick_draw.desc: Each turn, you may draw a single weapon or item carried on your person without using a minor action.

quick_hands.name: Quick Hands
quick_hands.desc: When you make a ranged attack, you may spend 2 AP to increase the Fire Rate of your gun by +2 for that attack.

rad_resistance.name: Rad Resistance
rad_resistance.desc: Your radiation Damage Resistance, to all hit locations, increases by +1 per rank in this perk.

refractor.name: Refractor
refractor.desc: Your energy Damage Resistance to all hit locations increases by +1 per rank in this perk.

ricochet.name: Ricochet
ricochet.desc: If an enemy rolls a complication on a ranged attack against you, you may spend 1 Luck point to have it hit them instead.

rifleman.name: Rifleman
rifleman.desc: When you attack with a non-heavy two-handed ranged weapon with Fire Rate 2 or lower, add +1 CD damage per rank.

robotics_expert.name: Robotics Expert
robotics_expert.desc: You can modify robot armor and modules. Higher ranks unlock better mods and allow reprogramming robots.

science.name: Science!
science.desc: You can modify energy weapons and craft advanced armor mods. Each rank unlocks an additional rank of mods.

scoundrel.name: Scoundrel
scoundrel.desc: When you make a CHA + Speech test to convince someone of a lie, you may ignore the first complication you roll.

scrapper.name: Scrapper
scrapper.desc: When you scrap an item, you can salvage uncommon component materials. Rank 2 allows salvaging rare materials.

scrounger.name: Scrounger
scrounger.desc: Whenever you roll to determine how much ammunition you find, you find more (+3, +6, or +10 CD per rank).

shotgun_surgeon.name: Shotgun Surgeon
shotgun_surgeon.desc: Your ranged attacks using shotguns gain the Piercing 1 damage effect (or add +1 to existing).

skilled.name: Skilled
skilled.desc: Add +1 rank to two skills or add +2 ranks to one skill (maximum of 6 ranks per skill).

size_matters.name: Size Matters
size_matters.desc: When you make a ranged attack with any heavy weapon, you add +1 CD to the weapon's damage, per rank.

slayer.name: Slayer
slayer.desc: When you inflict any damage with a melee/unarmed attack, you may spend 1 Luck point to immediately inflict a critical hit.

smooth_talker.name: Smooth Talker
smooth_talker.desc: When you make a Barter or Speech test as part of an opposed test, you may re-roll 1d20.

snakeater.name: Snakeater
snakeater.desc: Your poison Damage Resistance increases by +2.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.desc: When you take the Aim action and attack with an Accurate two-handed weapon, targeting a location doesn't increase difficulty.

solar_powered.name: Solar Powered
solar_powered.desc: For every hour you spend in direct sunlight, you heal 1 radiation damage.

steady_aim.name: Steady Aim
steady_aim.desc: When you take the Aim action, you may re-roll 2d20 on the first attack, or re-roll 1d20 on all attacks this turn.

strong_back.name: Strong Back
strong_back.desc: Your maximum carry weight is increased by +25 lbs. per rank.

tag.name: Tag!
tag.desc: Select one additional Tag skill. Increase its rank by 2 (max 6), allowing you to roll criticals on that skill.

terrifying_presence.name: Terrifying Presence
terrifying_presence.desc: Rank 1: Re-roll 1d20 when threatening. Rank 2: Use an action to force an enemy to move away on a successful test.

toughness.name: Toughness
toughness.desc: Your physical Damage Resistance to all hit locations increases by +1 per rank in this perk.
